dct_description_sm: Gravé par Erhard Fres. 35 bis. Rue Denfert-Rochereau Paris ; Imp. Erhard Fres.
Verso includes various statistical, trade, communications, and historical information on various African countries, with 6 ancillary maps.
Shows possessions and protectorates by colonial powers, railroads, land routes, water ways, region names, islands, towns.
June 1890 latest year mentioned--Fort Salisbury not present on map, but British central Africa extends to Lake Nyasa.

[Ancillary map 1] Le Cap [showing water depths] -- [Ancillary map 2] Champs de Diamants -- [Ancillary map 3] Réseau navigable du bassin du Congo -- [Ancillary map 4] Principaux itinéraires [Africa South of Equator] -- [Ancillary map 5] Grands lacs comparés au lac de Genéve -- [Ancillary map 6] Races [Inset map: [Madagascar]]
Page torn from verso not belonging to African continent.
